summary: Rest duration inserted after max_continuous_time. Required within layover_config.
businessRules: Adds to elapsed/working time and can push a route past the shift or max_working_time.

layover_duration defines: Specify the duration, in seconds, for which the driver should rest after driving continuously for the duration provided in max_continuous_time. This field is mandatory when using the layover_config…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.layover_config.max_continuous_time, vehicles.max_working_time. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Values in seconds; must be non-negative. Zero means instantaneous.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Interaction: rest time can breach max_working_time on long routes (C6).
Interaction: Infeasible: nearest task's leg alone exceeds max_travel_time -> vehicle serves nothing.
Interaction: Interaction: a 40-min wait for a late window pushes route end past the shift -> unassigned.
Interaction: Break duration: vehicle with max_working_time 480 and two 30-min breaks + 8h driving -> working time 480 (hits cap, no room for service).
Interaction: Layover: max_working_time 480, 120-min layover + 360-min driving -> working time exactly 480.
